titulo: Sydney Parkinson Maori War Canoe, 1769, Cook's first voyage
autor: Sydney Parkinson drew the original black-and-white drawing circa 1769 during Captain James Cook's first voyage. The original was then re-drawn in a colorized engraving which was published circa 1773 in a book titled "An Account of the Voyages Undertaken by the Order of his Present Majesty for Making Discoveries in..." edited by John Hawkesworth (book editor). The 1773 image is online at https://natlib.govt.nz/records/22861896 The image portrayed here was a second colorized version, drawn sometime after 1773, perhaps in 1784. The artist that did the engraving and colored it is unknown.
